newsitem.title: UK: Livshits says budget deal not a condition for IMF.
newsitem.headline: Livshits says budget deal not a condition for IMF.

text.p: Russian Finance Minister Alexander Livshits said on Friday that the passage of the 1997 budget through parliament was not a conditon for further help from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) next year.
"I have not heard about such a precondition," he told Reuters in London where he is heading a delegation to promote his country's planned Eurobond.
"But it's quite obvious that any country which respects itself has to have a budget before the beginning of the budget year," he added.
The IMF has delayed a tranche on its $10 billion loan to Russia, demanding proof that Moscow is bringing in more tax revenue.
Livshits said he would meet IMF opfficial next week when he gets back to Moscow.
He said there the chance was still there to get the 1997 budget approved before the end of the year.
A draft budget has been agreed, but Duma deputies have warned that does necessarily mean it will be approved by them when debate starts on November 22.
